Ethereum is a public permissionless blockchain. Ethereum uses proof-of-stake consensus since its 2022 Merge upgrade. Ethereum executes smart contracts on the Ethereum Virtual Machine. Ethereum uses ETH as its native token.

Cardano is a public permissionless blockchain. Cardano uses proof-of-stake consensus through the Ouroboros protocol. Cardano uses the extended UTXO accounting model for smart contracts. Cardano uses ADA as its native token.

Solana is a public permissionless blockchain. Solana uses proof-of-stake consensus combined with a Proof of History mechanism. Solana runs smart contracts, called programs, mainly written in Rust. Solana uses SOL as its native token.

Bitcoin blockchain is a public permissionless blockchain. Bitcoin blockchain uses proof-of-work consensus. Bitcoin blockchain offers a limited, non-Turing-complete scripting language rather than general-purpose smart contracts. Bitcoin blockchain uses BTC as its native currency.

Fantom is a public permissionless blockchain. Fantom uses the Lachesis aBFT consensus mechanism. Fantom is compatible with the Ethereum Virtual Machine. Fantom uses FTM as its native token.
